facts.text: The county’s 2026 repair notice closes camping and lake access for fishing, boating and kayaking. Camping stays closed until further notice; no reopening date is confirmed.
facts.quote: Camping and lake access are also closed for the 2026 season.

facts.text: Lake Access Road is closed beyond the pavilion/maintenance-garage turnoff, including to pedestrians, joggers, bicycles and vehicles.
facts.quote: Lake Access Road: Closed beyond the turnoff to the pavilion and maintenance garage. This closure applies to all traffic, including vehicles, motorcycles, bicycles, pedestrians, and joggers.

facts.text: The repair notice closes both sides of the dam/spillway, horse trails and the equestrian area, and disc-golf holes 7 and 8.
facts.quote: Areas Closed Beginning July 31 Lake Access Road: Closed beyond the turnoff to the pavilion and maintenance garage. This closure applies to all traffic, including vehicles, motorcycles, bicycles, pedestrians, and joggers. Equestrian Area and Horse Trails: Closed until further notice. Disc Golf Course: Holes 7 and 8 will be closed. The remaining holes stay open. Dam and Spillway: Access is closed on both sides of the dam and spillway. New safety signs and fencing are being installed in AJ Jolly Park and the dam area to restrict access to contracted construction crews. Visitors are asked to observe all posted signage, plan their visits accordingly, and use caution around work zones. The County appreciates the patience and understanding of park visitors as these improvements are completed, and thanks the community for helping keep AJ Jolly Park safe for everyone.

facts.text: The repair FAQ describes limited toilets: portable units in some areas, bathhouses by Stapleton Pavilion, the playground and private picnic areas for the 2026 season, and closed campground bathhouses. It does not specify toilet access features.
facts.quote: Restrooms are limited. Portable restrooms are provided in certain areas. The bathhouses near Stapleton Pavilion, the accessible playground, and the private picnic areas are open for the 2026 season. Bathhouses in the campground areas are closed.

facts.text: The parks department’s general winter schedule (November 1–March 1) says bathrooms are closed and portable toilets available. This differs from the repair FAQ’s seasonal bathhouse wording; confirm the specific toilet before travelling.
facts.quote: Winter Season: November 1 - March 1 Entrance gates open during daytime hours (weather permitting) Bathrooms closed; Port-o-lets available

facts.text: Tree Frog shelter is near the ranger station inside Gate 1, beside the county-described accessible playground. Its listing gives six wooden picnic tables, an additional concrete patio and a bathroom; table clearances and connecting surfaces are not specified.
facts.quote: Tree Frog Located at Gate 1 inside main park area Shelter is near Ranger Station Adjacent to the Accessible Playground 6 Wooden Picnic tables, additional concrete patio Electric, water, bathroom Capacity: 36 seated

facts.text: The county’s December 2024 completed-work report records shade canopies, benches and fencing at the playground. This historical report does not confirm today’s condition.
facts.quote: Shade canopies, benches, and fence installed at the ADA Accessible and Inclusive Playground at AJ Jolly Park

facts.text: The December 2024 completed-work report records a sidewalk and crosswalk to the front playground and repaving of the walking loop from park entrance to exit. It is not a current route inspection.
facts.quote: Re-paved walking trail loop from park entrance to park exit at AJ Jolly Park • New directional striping/parking at the entrance to AJ Jolly Park to enhance safety • Addition of new road signage to direct patrons to large shelters along Racetrack Road • Replaced signage at all the tee pads on the disc golf course • Addition of a sidewalk and crosswalk to playground near the front of AJ Jolly Park • O ver -head storage area built in the Maintenance Shop at AJ Jolly Park •

facts.text: The December 2024 report records bathroom changing tables, without giving sizes, capacities or adult-changing features.
facts.quote: Changing tables added to bathrooms at AJ Jolly Park

facts.text: The repair FAQ warns of possible temporary odor from exposed lake sediment.
facts.quote: You may notice a mild natural smell from exposed sediment at times. It will be temporary and closely monitored.

facts.text: For shelter reservations, the county directs visitors to call 859-547-3681. Its park page warns that dredging can leave normally lakeside sites without water.
facts.quote: Due to lake dredging some sites with normal lake access may not have water. Individual pictures, rates and other detailed information about each of our available shelters both at AJ Jolly Park as well as Pendery Park. To reserve a shelter please call Campbell County Parks at 859-547-3681.

facts.text: The repair FAQ says construction-area trails are closed and nearby trailheads may be restricted. Follow its posted closure map and work-zone signs.
facts.quote: Many are. Trails inside the marked construction area are closed, and a few trailheads near work zones may be restricted. Please check the posted closure map before you head out.

facts.text: The repair FAQ warns of increased construction traffic near the park entrance.
facts.quote: There will be more construction traffic near the park entrance. Crews will work to keep disruptions to a minimum.

additionalSupport.quote: No. The work in that area makes it unsafe for visitors, so camping is closed until further notice. We will announce reopening and reservation plans once the schedule is set.
No. The dredging work requires the lake to be fully closed for everyone's safety.
There will be more construction traffic near the park entrance. Crews will work to keep disruptions to a minimum.

address_quote: Pendery Park, 4113 Williams Ln, Melbourne, KY 41059

facts.text: For the rear shelters, the county directs arrivals across the railroad tracks, then along the second road on the right to its end. This is a vehicle-direction description, not a verified step-free route or assessment of the crossing.
facts.quote: After entering Pendery Park, go across railroad tracks and turn on the second road on the right. Proceed to the end of the road.

facts.text: The rental page lists four rear shelters. Shelter 1 has twelve wooden picnic tables and a portable toilet, with a playground and basketball court nearby. Toilet access features and distances are not given.
facts.quote: Pendery Shelter 1 Located at the back of Pendery Park on the left. Largest shelter in the park. 12 Wooden Picnic Tables, Port-a-Let Basketball Court, Playground, Corn-Hole, Ballfields all within walking distance Capacity: 72 seated

facts.text: The park overview lists five picnic shelters and gives 859-547-3681 for reservations. The separate rental page lists four; confirm the shelter and its location when booking.
facts.quote: In addition, the park offers 5 picnic shelters with tables for you and your family to enjoy a fun-filled day of activities. Shelter Reservations: 859-547-3681

facts.text: The department’s general winter schedule, November 1–March 1, lists daytime gates subject to weather, closed bathrooms and portable toilets. Features and exact portable-toilet locations are not described.
facts.quote: Winter Season: November 1 - March 1 Entrance gates open during daytime hours (weather permitting) Bathrooms closed; Port-o-lets available

facts.text: The park overview lists a three-quarter-mile walking trail without surface, gradient or rest-point details. This does not identify the separate nature-trail proposal.
facts.quote: The 72-acre Pendery Sports Park offers an array of sporting facilities to meet the needs of outdoor enthusiasts- 8 baseball fields, 1 NBA size basketball court, 6 soccer fields, and a three-quarter mile walking trail.

facts.text: The county’s December 2024 completed-work report records a playground with a shade canopy, described by the county as accessible and inclusive. It does not provide equipment-by-equipment access details.
facts.quote: New ADA Accessible and Inclusive Playground with shade canopy installed at Pendery Park

facts.text: The same December 2024 completed-work report records repaving of problem areas on the walking trail. It does not establish today’s surface condition or a continuous route from parking.
facts.quote: Re-paved trouble areas on the walking trail at Pendery Park

address_quote: We are in Suite 416 in the Linncinnati building located at 516 Linn Street in Cincinnati.

facts.text: The studio describes a ramp entrance through Lot B and an elevator through the front door.
facts.quote: Yes, there is a ramp entrance to the building through Lot B. The elevator is located through the front door. We can provide accommodations in class as well.

facts.text: Suite 416 is on the fourth floor, at the building’s back, in a narrow hallway off the main hallway. No clearance is given.
facts.quote: When you walk in the building, you can either take the stairs next to the entrance or take the elevator to the fourth floor. We are located at the back of the building. You will find Suite 416 in a narrow hallway off the main hallway.

facts.text: Lot A is off Linn Street; Lot B is off West 5th Street. The pig mural is on the building’s rear facing River Road.
facts.quote: The Linncinnati building has two parking lots. When you see the building, the mural of Ginger the pig is on the backside of the building facing River Road. On the front side of the building, there are two parking lots. Lot A is off of Linn Street. Lot B is off of West 5th Street.

facts.text: There is a shared bathroom and drinking fountain on the fourth floor; the studio has no private bathroom. Toilet layout and changing facilities are not described.
facts.quote: We do not have a private bathroom. There is a bathroom and a drinking fountain on the fourth floor where we are located. We strongly suggest using the restroom before coming to class.

facts.text: The studio offers in-class accommodations and tailored private sessions, without describing specific adaptations, transfer assistance or chair-based classes. Ask about the selected session before booking.
facts.quote: We can provide accommodations in class as well.

facts.text: Yoga mats are available to use free of charge, and practice props are provided and cleaned after use. The FAQ otherwise suggests bringing your own mat.
facts.quote: It is suggested that you bring your own yoga mat, but we also provide yoga mats available to use free of charge. We provide props in the practice space. These props are cleaned after each use.

facts.text: Studio rules ask visitors to enter and leave quietly and prohibit phone use in the practice space. A quiet room is not described.
facts.quote: Enter and exit the space quietly. Remove your shoes and place personal belongings at the studio entrance. No cell phone use in the practice space.

facts.text: Classes cancelled more than two hours before the start receive a full refund. Cancellations inside that window and unattended classes do not receive a refund.
facts.quote: You can cancel a class before the two-hour window of a class start time and receive a full refund. Within the two-hour window, classes cancelled or unattended will not receive a refund.

additionalSupport.quote: Schedule a private one-on-one session or a private group session with one of our instructors. We will tailor the class to your needs.

facts.quote: Washington Park's wide open parking decks are illuminated by natural sunlight during the day with three broad stairwells and glass elevator shafts located on the northeast corner, northwest corner, and across from the Music Hall entrance.
facts.text: The underground garage has glass elevators at its northeast and northwest corners and across from the Music Hall entrance.

facts.quote: New accessible playgrounds were recently constructed at Smale Riverfront Park, Westwood Town Hall Park, Ziegler Park, Washington Park, Belleview Park and Alms Park.
facts.text: A Cincinnati Parks article published in July 2020 lists Washington Park among parks where accessible playgrounds had been built. It does not describe individual play features.
facts.previousText: Cincinnati Parks lists Washington Park among the parks where new accessible playgrounds were built.

facts.quote: In certain circumstances, primarily when events are actively taking place, the electrical outlets in certain locations in Washington Park can be made available to park patrons for medically necessary devices. If you must charge your medically necessary equipment, 3CDC staff members will work to accommodate you to the best of our ability during your visit to Washington Park. To access a power source for your medically necessary equipment, visit the Washington Park Porch and ask as staff member for proper accommodations. Note that if no events are taking place during your visit and/or the Washington Park Porch is closed, you should seek out a 3CDC operations staff member, and staff will try to accommodate your request.
facts.text: Charging medically necessary equipment depends on staff and available outlets, primarily during events. Ask at the Porch; if it is closed or no event is taking place, seek 3CDC operations staff. Staff say they will try to accommodate the request; power is not guaranteed.
facts.previousText: To charge medically necessary equipment, ask staff at the Washington Park Porch.

facts.quote: The Porch is the perfect place to kick back and relax at the Park. The space features a large, shaded deck area with life-sized games, cornhole, and plenty of tables and seating. The Porch proudly features Coca-Cola products and beer offerings from local favorites Rhinegeist , The Christian Moerlein Brewing Company , Bud Light , and Fifty West Brewing Company . Bike Racks Expand Washington Park has three bicycle racks for the convenience of cyclists. All three racks are located at the 13th Street entrance. Unless specifically allowed as part of a permitted event, bicycle riding is prohibited at Washington Park. Go Vibrant Play Equipment Expand Play equipment, from Go Vibrant, is free to check out at Washington Park. To check items out, please speak with a Play Worker at the Children's Playground. Restrooms Expand Public Restrooms are located at Race Street (open 9a-11p daily), Elm Street (open during events), and at the Children's Playground (open from 9a-10p daily, for children and parents in the Children's Playground only). They are regularly cleaned and stocked by Washington Park Customer Service Representatives (CSRs). Restroom attendants are also on duty inside the restrooms during larger events. Should one find the restroom closed during the hours it should be open, available CSRs would be happy to explain why, or open it up when possible.
facts.text: Public restrooms are at Race Street (9 a.m.–11 p.m. daily), Elm Street (during events) and the Children’s Playground (9 a.m.–10 p.m., only for children and parents using the playground). Ask customer service staff about an unexpectedly closed restroom. Physical access features are not described. The same page describes the Porch’s shaded deck, tables and seating.
facts.previousText: Public restrooms are at Race Street (9 a.m. to 11 p.m. daily), Elm Street (during events) and the Children's Playground. Their accessibility is not stated. The Porch has a large shaded deck with plenty of tables and seating.

facts.quote: Washington Park is open from 6a-11p for the enjoyment of all.
facts.text: The park is open 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.
Garage vehicle entrances/exits are on Race Street at 13th Street and on Elm Street across from Music Hall. These are vehicle directions, not a confirmed pedestrian route.
facts.quote: Two vehicular entrances/exits are located on Race Street at 13th Street, and on Elm Street across from Music Hall.

facts.text: Take the garage ticket with you. Pay-on-foot machines in the three elevator lobbies accept cash or credit card before returning to the car; put the paid ticket into the exit machine. Reach and assistance features are not described.
facts.quote: Take your ticket with you! As you walk back to your car, stop at one of the pay station machines to pay your parking fee using cash or credit card. Pay stations allow you to pay for parking in any of the three elevator lobbies before returning to your vehicle. As you drive out, simply feed your paid ticket into the machine, and the arm will raise.

facts.text: For November 2–December 31, 2026, the Porch schedule lists Friday 3–8 p.m. and Saturday–Sunday 11 a.m.–8 p.m. This is the Porch’s schedule, separate from park opening hours and conditional charging assistance.
facts.quote: November 2 - December 31 Friday | 3:00 - 8:00p Saturday & Sunday | 11:00a - 8:00p

facts.text: Playground rules require adults to be accompanied by a child and children to be supervised by a responsible adult. This restriction is specific to the playground.
facts.quote: All adults must be accompanied by a child Children must be supervised by a responsible adult
